script: One of the biggest turtles that ever lived was Archelon. It grew to about 4 meters long. It swam in a shallow sea that once covered the middle of North America. That was about 75 million years ago, while dinosaurs walked on land. Its shell was not solid, but a framework of bone covered by tough skin. Today's leatherback sea turtle is one of its living relatives. Follow DinoBytes for more prehistoric facts.
